category: Application Library examples: Porous Media Flow Module
description: Ready-made, documented example simulations installed with the Porous Media Flow Module. Each lists its physics interfaces, couplings and study steps; solve one with comsol_run_example or adapt its Java build script.

tools.name: Ceramic Water Filter with Activated Carbon Core [Porous Media Flow Module example]
tools.description: Application Library example of the Porous Media Flow Module (Solute Transport): Ceramic Water Filter with Activated Carbon Core. Physics interfaces: Darcy's Law (dl), Laminar Flow (spf), Transport of Diluted Species (tds). Multiphysics couplings: NavierStokesDarcyCoupling. Study steps: Stationary, Time Dependent. A ready model to start from for a similar simulation.
tools.usage: MCP: comsol_run_example("Porous_Media_Flow_Module/Solute_Transport/ceramic_water_filter") to solve it, comsol_example_info("ceramic_water_filter", include_java=true) for its build script. COMSOL: File > Application Libraries > Porous Media Flow Module > Solute Transport > ceramic water filter
